issue.title: Artifacts sub-tab descriptions
issue.description: Every Artifacts sub-tab — the five built-ins, the Plan pane, and every pane a sidecar ref creates — carries a resolved, never-empty description that the TUI renders as an accent-anchored pane brief under the sub-tab strip and as a hover tooltip on the strip itself, with the copy configurable per pane from a sidecar's ref spec or the user's sase.yml.

issue.title: Pane description resolution layer
issue.description: resolve: add a total, auditable description resolution ladder (user config → provider ref.pane → built-in copy → generated fallback), author the built-in copy, carry summary/body/source on the compiled pane contract, fix the descriptor cache token, and expose it all through sase artifact pane show and the config schema.

issue.title: The pane brief
issue.description: brief: render the resolved description as a host-owned accent-gutter brief under the Artifacts sub-tab strip, with an off/summary/full mode cycled by a new key, a click, or the command palette and seeded from config.

issue.title: Sub-tab hover tooltips
issue.description: hover: teach the shared PanelTabStrip to carry a per-tab description and show it as a hover tooltip using the same cell-accurate hit test its click handler uses, then feed it the Artifacts descriptors.

issue.title: Visual goldens and end-to-end verification
issue.description: goldens: add new PNG goldens for the brief's three modes and the unconfigured provider hint, rebaseline every Artifacts golden the new row shifts, and run the full verification lane.

payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: During unrelated case-aware word-completion verification on 2026-08-26, `just check` escalated to the governed full test lane (core-identity-changed) and failed exactly `tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_scaffold.py::test_subtab_strip_labels_and_accents_cover_all_panes` after 37,198 tests passed. Focused reproduction on the same tree also fails: `.venv/bin/pytest tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_scaffold.py::test_subtab_strip_labels_and_accents_cover_all_panes -vv` reports that the test expects `ARTIFACTS_SUBTAB_ORDER == ("agents", "stitches", "patches", "beads", "agents", "files")`, but runtime has `("agents", "stitches", "patches", "beads", "files")`. No Artifacts source or test files are dirty in this word-completion change. This is causally linked to the active Artifacts sub-tab descriptions epic, especially phase `sase-u6.4` (visual goldens and end-to-end verification), rather than a new standalone task.

DISCOVERED ISSUE: During file_ref_pool_extension_and_relative_path verification at c8a3c606871efe8cfe86dec918f477e9d05b17d6, `just check` escalated to the governed full test lane and failed exactly `tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_scaffold.py::test_subtab_strip_labels_and_accents_cover_all_panes`; focused rerun of the same node also failed. Assertion expects `ARTIFACTS_SUBTAB_ORDER == ("agents", "stitches", "patches", "beads", "agents", "files")`, but runtime is `("agents", "stitches", "patches", "beads", "files")`. The current diff touches file-ref capture/rendering tests/docs, not ACE TUI scaffold/source. This independently corroborates note #1 on this active epic and remains causally linked to phase `sase-u6.4`.

DISCOVERED ISSUE: While implementing plan:202608/ci_green_repair.md on 2026-08-26, targeted Agent-pane PNG tests passed 6/6 after updating only the six approved artifacts_agents_* goldens, but the full 'just test-visual' lane failed broadly with 334 failed / 476 passed / 1 skipped in 817.81s. The first sampled failures time out waiting for artifacts_subtab='patches' after page.press('2') while the last observed subtab is 'stitches', and the failure list spans many unrelated visual modules. I recorded the standing-backlog corroboration as +1 on task sase-r5; this note is here because the sampled signature is Artifacts sub-tab navigation and phase sase-u6.4 owns visual goldens/end-to-end verification for sub-tab work.
Implemented pane description resolution; verified targeted pytest, editable pane CLI schema v3 payload, clean epic-symbols, and just check passed.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: docs/configuration.md shared-key allowlist table is missing 2 of the 9 pairs already in `_CONTEXTUAL_APP_DUPLICATES` (src/sase/ace/tui/keymaps/registry.py) — `agents_revive`/`beads_launch_work` and `agents_revive`/`reword`. Pre-existing drift, noticed while adding the new `toggle_attempt_view`/`cycle_artifacts_description` row for this phase.

Implemented the pane brief: new artifacts_description.py mode helpers, shell.build_pane_brief renderer, ArtifactsPaneBrief widget wired into ArtifactsView (compose/on_mount/switch_to/set_keymap_registry/click), AceApp.artifacts_description_mode reactive seeded from ace.artifacts.description_mode with a watcher, action_cycle_artifacts_description wired through keymaps/bindings/availability/command-palette/help-modal, D-key collision with toggle_attempt_view resolved via an explicit agents-tab gate plus a new keymaps registry allowlist pair, docs updated (ace.md, artifacts_pane_visual_grammar.md, configuration.md). Verified with new tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_pane_brief.py and test_artifacts_description_modes.py, plus fixed a pre-existing stub-app test (test_artifacts_query_bar_invariant.py) that needed the new reactive stubbed. Full just check (lint + scoped test escalated to full suite, 37268 passed) is green.

Auto-closed by `sase stitch create` after create_commit landed 23b7abf1b ("feat(tui): add tooltips to panel tab strip"). No verification is implied by this note. Reopen with `sase bead open sase-u6.3`, or pass `-B|--do-not-close-bead` on mid-flight commits.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: just check-full flake-baseline gate (selection-health --fail-on-new-flake) is red on pre-existing reproducible flakes unrelated to this phase (Artifacts pane-description PNG goldens touch no code these tests exercise) — the same gate sase-u7 and its siblings already track (7 nodes over baseline, most already filed). Not fixed here; land agent should confirm sase-u7 et al. cover the current red set before landing sase-u6.

Added Artifacts pane-description PNG coverage (test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_descriptions.py, 4 new goldens) and rebaselined the Artifacts PNG corpus + Files-pane visual sentinels for the new brief row. just test-visual (artifacts subset, incl. isolated split-wide check) passed; just check passed. just check-full: recalibrated tests/perf/baselines/test_cost_budgets.json against the new suite cost (verified via tools/check_test_cost_budgets and the cost-budget test modules) and it now passes; the remaining check-full failure is selection-health's --fail-on-new-flake gate on 7 pre-existing reproducible flakes unrelated to this phase's diff, already tracked by sase-u7 and siblings (see note) — not something this phase caused or should fix.

RESUMED LANDING after child epic sase-u6.5 closed. sase-u6.land left no prior landing
note; it had filed sase-ub and sase-uc and then handed off to sase-u6.5, so this close
completes the interrupted landing. Rechecked every descendant, every note, the linked
plan, and post-child drift at HEAD 8d074c8dd on a clean tree.

DESCENDANT READINESS. All four phases plus the child epic are closed done. sase-u6.3
was auto-closed by `sase stitch create` with "no verification is implied", so it was
verified here rather than taken on trust: commit 23b7abf1b adds the per-tab description
and cell-accurate hit test to panel_tab_strip.py, wires it from artifacts/view.py, and
ships tests/ace/tui/test_panel_tab_strip_tooltips.py with five tests including a
parametrized cell-accuracy check at every tier — all pass. sase-u6.5's own landing is
recorded on that bead.

GOAL VERIFIED END TO END, not just by unit tests. `sase artifact pane show` resolves a
non-empty summary and body for all five built-ins and the Plan pane at rung `builtin`,
and for the provider pane ref:research at rung `provider` for the summary with
`fallback` for the body — so the ladder is total across config -> provider ref.pane ->
built-in -> generated fallback, exactly as the goal requires. Focused feature suite
(pane descriptions, pane brief, description modes, tab-strip tooltips, contract compiler,
pane declarations, artifact pane, config schema extensions): 105 passed. Artifacts visual
family (13 modules, 45 nodes): all pass at exact pixel equality. `just check`: every lint
gate green (fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, feature flags, pyscripts, test waits, changelog,
patch/stitch terminology, symvision, toobig, SASE validation, committed plans) plus the
scoped test lane, exit 0. `sase bead epic-symbols sase-u6`: no entries.

POST-CHILD DRIFT: none. The child's commit 8d074c8dd is HEAD and origin/master is in sync
after a fetch.

THE THREE DISCOVERED ISSUE NOTES ON THIS BEAD ARE ALL RESOLVED.
  - Notes 1 and 2 (agents 0e3 and 0e5) reported
    test_artifacts_scaffold.py::test_subtab_strip_labels_and_accents_cover_all_panes
    failing, and both attributed it to phase sase-u6.4. That attribution was WRONG.
    `git log -L 518,532:tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_scaffold.py` shows the duplicate
    "agents" entry in the expected ARTIFACTS_SUBTAB_ORDER tuple was added by 4dd299502
    ("put agents first in subtabs", plan 202608/agent_first_artifacts_subtab.md) and
    removed by 179508566, neither of which belongs to sase-u6. The node passes at HEAD.
  - Note 3 (agent 0e6) reported the broad `just test-visual` red; 0e6 had already routed
    it to sase-r5, and this landing corroborated it further (see below).

DISCHARGED sase-u6.4's NOTE 1, which asked this land agent to confirm sase-u7 et al.
cover the flake-baseline red set before landing. THEY DID NOT. The gate now reports 9
nodes over baseline, not the 7 sase-u6.4 measured. Seven have beads (sase-ty, sase-r2,
sase-tz, sase-u0, sase-u7, sase-u1, and sase-sf for a sibling param of the same test).
The two without were resolved rather than left for the next agent:
  - test_artifacts_scaffold.py::test_subtab_strip_labels_and_accents_cover_all_panes —
    +1 on sase-o0 ("declare fixed-at retirement for already-fixed nodes"). It was never
    a flake: deterministic, caused by 4dd299502, fixed by 179508566 at
    2026-08-26T13:45:54Z, and all 17 of its failure records predate that fix (the two
    newest are on tree c8a3c606871e at 12:24Z and 12:25Z). Supplied the exact
    `# fixed-at:` line the bead's mechanism needs.
  - test_keymaps_display_help.py::test_all_tab_help_guides_show_forward_jump_and_agents_metadata_sections
    — filed as sase-uf (task(flake), large, ready). 12 failures on 2026-08-25 across

    retired as stale evidence. It is a pure synchronous keymap-registry assertion with
    nothing local to race, so it was linked related -> sase-j7 (the process-global-state
    leak epic) and related -> sase-u7 (same gate, same landing-blocking shape).

FOLLOW-UPS ACROSS THE WHOLE EPIC. sase-ub (docs shared-key allowlist, from sase-u6.2
note 1) and sase-uc (sidecar-ref keys in the public config schema, from the resolve
phase) were already filed by sase-u6.land. From the child epic: sase-ue (the
_zoom_agent collection error from f4b827af6). From this landing: sase-uf, plus +1s on
sase-r5 and sase-o0. Nothing was declined without a recorded reason.

ONE SCOPE TENSION RECORDED DELIBERATELY. This plan's goldens phase says every existing
golden the brief shifts must be rebaselined, and names the copy_as_stitches_* family
alongside artifacts_*. sase-u6.4 rebaselined artifacts_* only. Auditing every actual.svg
under .pytest_cache/sase-visual/ for the six default pane summaries found 25 goldens
outside the artifacts_* prefix that now render the brief but were last rebaselined by
pre-epic commit e8de34fe0, plus the two changespecs_onboarding goldens. They were NOT
repaired here, and that is a considered call, not an oversight: two of the four copy_as
nodes are in sase-r5's own enumerated 36-node list from 2026-08-19, a week before this
epic existed; all 27 were already red from 4dd299502 and earlier drift before the brief
was written; repairing them requires accepting 4dd299502's sub-tab reorder, which is not
this epic's change to accept; and child plan
202608/artifacts_description_visual_residue.md — authored by this epic's own land agent
as the governing attribution rule — says failures already matching sase-r5 remain that
backlog and must not be updated or duplicated. All 27 are named explicitly in this
landing's +1 on sase-r5, with the copy_as diff read by eye and confirmed to be exactly
the reorder, the brief row, and the one-row shift, so the repair accepts the brief
deliberately. If you would rather they had been rebaselined here, that is a one-module
follow-up on sase-r5, not lost work.
